page.overview:
Who is Deirta Thelyss?

Deirta Thelyss is the mother of Essek and Verin Thelyss, and the leader of one of the three ruling dens of the Kryn Dynasty. In The Mighty Nein, Deirta is voiced by Anjelica Huston.

In her most recent life Deirta is a drow woman with pale hair, purple skin, and green eyes, wearing silver and red jewelry.

She is "deeply steeped" in Dynasty culture.

Deirta was consecuted a long time ago, becoming a follower of The Luxon and living multiple lives, reincarnation after reincarnation, until she became an Umavi, a "perfect soul" revered in the Kryn Dynasty. During her most recent life, which started at some point before the 8th century after the Divergence, she is the leader of Den Thelyss, which wishes to see the Dynasty established within the world and respected by others.
